# webtables/sub

> Subtraction: `-`, with `i64.sub`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/sub.pkg) · translates [std/sub](../std/sub.md)

    WebAssembly evaluates the operands left to right, as bintables does.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.sub
{left}
{right}
)
```
